name: Uninstallation & relocation
tagline: Move your AC without losing gas or damaging parts
summary: Safe removal and reinstallation when you move home or office.
description: Moving an AC is more than unscrewing it from the wall. We pump down the refrigerant into the outdoor unit, seal the lines, and dismantle everything carefully, so the system can be reinstalled at your new location without losing gas or damaging parts.
duration: 1 – 1.5 hours to uninstall; 3 – 4 hours to reinstall
suitable_for: Split, window, cassette and tower ACs
includes: Refrigerant pump-down to save existing gas
Careful dismantling and capping of pipes
Reinstallation with new piping where required
Leak test and cooling check at the new site
signs: You're renovating or repainting the room
You want to move the AC to another room

options.name: Uninstall + reinstall
options.detail: Complete move to a new location

process.title: Pump-down
process.text: Refrigerant is pumped into the outdoor unit to save it.

process.title: Dismantle
process.text: Units are removed and pipes capped to keep out dust and moisture.

process.title: Reinstall
process.text: We fit the units at the new site, with new piping if needed.

process.title: Test
process.text: Leak test and cooling check before handover.

faqs.question: Will I need a gas refill after moving?
faqs.answer: Not usually. With a proper pump-down the gas is saved. A top-up may be needed if extra piping is added.

faqs.question: Can the old copper pipe be reused?
faqs.answer: Sometimes, if it's in good condition and long enough. Otherwise we recommend new piping.
